title: Homogeneity of corporate risk perceptions and systemic financial risk
core_idea: Use text mining on firms' risk factor disclosures to extract perceived risks and quantify the homogeneity of corporate risk perceptions in order to examine their relationship with financial interconnectedness and systemic risk.
tldr: The paper applies text-mining to corporate risk disclosures to measure how similar firms' risk perceptions are and investigates how that similarity relates to financial interconnectedness and systemic financial risk.
